/guides/bo6-liberty-falls: Build the Jet Gun, capture two special enemies for Panos and survive the church finale. This guide covers the solo or co-op main quest, all nine Aetherella figures, bowling, the bank vault and the map’s reward secrets. The guaranteed Jet Gun route keeps the quest independent of Mystery Box luck. Use Quick Parts…
/guides/bo6-terminus: Restore the prison’s power, decode the Research Office, confront Nathan and stop Patient 13. This solo/co-op route includes a visual Beamsmasher solver, every network repair search, the timed hack-to-bomb transition, and the major island side quests. Use a boat for island work, read the current match’s clues, and…
/guides/bo6-citadelle-des-morts: Forge all four elemental swords, prepare their incantations and pass the knights’ trials to face the Guardian. This solo or co-op route includes every sword, the full bottle/book puzzle, boss preparation and the map’s substantial side quests. Use Standard mode for the full set of optional secrets. The visual helpers…
/guides/bo6-the-tomb: Build and upgrade the Staff of Ice, return four fragile trial charges and defeat the Sentinel Artifact. The full solo/co-op route below includes the real rock-glyph helper, both constellation puzzles, every statue trial and the map’s major side rewards. Use Standard mode for the full set of optional secrets. Bring a…
/guides/bo6-shattered-veil: This complete route assumes Standard mode. Repair the mansion’s elevator, obtain all three Ray Gun Mark II variants and free the spirits in three painting rituals before facing Z-Rex. Solo players can swap one Mark II between completed workbenches. The route below keeps each variant beside its matching ritual, with…
/guides/bo6-reckoning: This complete route assumes Standard mode, solo or co-op. Restore Project Janus, grow the Gorgofex, rebuild Franken-Klaus and make the Bio-Aetheric Portal safe before choosing a final opponent. /guides/cw-die-maschine: Open Projekt Endstation, build the Aetherscope and all four D.I.E. variants, then help Orlov shut the accelerator down. This guide includes the free weapon, every upgrade route, side rewards and the final escape. Solo or 2–4 players.
/guides/cw-firebase-z: Restore the three reactors, build the RAI K-84 and recover the right Mimic memories to rescue Samantha Maxis. Includes illustrated crystal tests, the dartboard solver, free perks, upgraded Monkey Bombs and free jump pads. Solo or 2–4 players.
/guides/cw-mauer-der-toten: Build Klaus, unlock a CRBR-S, and turn the hidden laboratory’s warhead against Valentina. The guide includes all safe-clue sightlines, every harvester location, optional Klaus upgrades, the nightclub and rooftop target challenge. Solo or 2–4 players.
/guides/cw-forsaken: Lift the lockdown, forge the Chrysalax and escort the Aetherium Neutralizer into the final battle. Includes the TV memory game for free perks, Ronald Raygun’s deliveries, arcade games, weapon challenges and Samantha’s Ballad. Solo or 2–4 players.
/guides/cw-outbreak: One survival mode across eight regions, with two separate story quests. Use this hub for region-specific locations, D.I.E. upgrades, world events and the Zoo Pact; open a quest below for its full walkthrough and independent saved progress. Play Outbreak Endless for the main quests.
/guides/bo4-dead-of-the-night: A complete route through Trial by Ordeal: open the forest, prepare silver ammunition and Alistair’s Annihilator, collect three quest stones, then trap the werewolf. Use a standard Normal-or-higher match without Custom Mutations for the main quest. The recommended first-clear order is Telescope → Knights → Effigy; the…
/guides/bo4-ix: Venerated Warrior, from your first Arena challenge to Fury and Wrath. Use a standard match on Normal or higher without Custom Mutations. Start the slow Danu preparations early; the Ra helper lets you tap the actual obelisk glyphs and gives the enemy kill order. Quick Parts is the in-match route; Full Details includes…
/guides/bo4-voyage-of-despair: Abandon Ship — a complete solo or co-op route through the Titanic. Play a standard Normal-or-higher match without Custom Mutations. Start with the Sentinel, shield and Kraken, solve the clocks, complete four elemental trials, then follow the planets to the Eye. Quick Parts tracks the run; Full Details includes…
/guides/bo4-blood-of-the-dead: Break the cycle at Alcatraz. Play a standard match on Normal difficulty or higher, without Custom Mutations. Start with the shield and Retriever, recover the Kronorium, then free five spirits in the order your run gives you. Use Quick Parts while playing or Full Details to learn each step; the puzzle helpers share…
/guides/bo4-ancient-evil: Greek Tragedy, with a complete route through Delphi, the hands, theater and the final arena. Play a standard Normal-or-higher match without Custom Mutations. Build Charon first, work on tribute rewards during setup, and use the Oracle helper to jump straight to the pictured hand location. Each equipment branch below…
/guides/bo4-alpha-omega: Follow Rushmore’s experiments, rebuild the A.D.A.M. unit and contain the Avogadro. The main quest supports solo or co-op on Normal difficulty or above, without Custom Mutations. Galvaknuckles and Telepads are required; the four elemental Mark II variants are optional. Use Quick Parts during a run and Full Details for…
/guides/bo4-tag-der-toten: Help the Hermit assemble the Agarthan Device. Play solo or co-op on Normal or above without Custom Mutations. This guide separates all three orb rituals, the four ordinary Pack-a-Punch charges and the final Golden charge. The guaranteed Wunderwaffe and Music Box routes keep the quest moving without relying on Mystery…
/guides/bo4-classified: Two separate objectives share the same Pentagon setup. Project Skadi gives a free Winter’s Howl and the Cold War Remedy achievement; the story ending requires reaching round 150. Start with the amplifier and shield, follow the four pictured code clues for the weapon, or use the dedicated endurance section for the…
/guides/bo3-shadows-of-evil: Open Morg City with Beast mode, build the swords and confront the Shadowman. The complete Apocalypse Averted ending requires four players in standard play; solo players can reach the Shadowman capture. Includes equipment upgrades, songs, the Margwa Mask and visual train glyphs.
/guides/bo3-the-giant: Link the teleporters, complete Paradoxical Prologue (Fly Trap), and reveal the hidden sixth perk. This is the BO3 version of Der Riese: perk positions, weapons and rewards differ from World at War and BO1. Solo or 2–4 players; Fly Trap has no boss arena.
/guides/bo3-der-eisendrache: A complete My Brother’s Keeper route with all four bow upgrades, the Ragnarok DG-4, photographed symbol helpers and optional secrets. Solo or 2–4 players. For a minimal-bow run, use Solo Game or a ranked private match; unranked/offline quest runs require all four bows.
/guides/bo3-zetsubou-no-shima: A complete Seeds of Doubt route for 1–4 players, with permanent power, every required buildable, plant care, all three cogs, Masamune and the island’s optional rewards. Equip the classic Anywhere But Here GobbleGum before loading in: one elevator cog requires it. Start plants and trials early so growth rounds overlap…
/guides/bo3-gorod-krovi: A complete Love and War route for 1–4 players: dragon travel, shield and Gauntlet, all trophies and challenges, the two-part boss fight, equipment upgrades and optional rewards. The valve helper calculates settings from your two observations; the bomb helper records SOPHIA’s actual order with location photographs.…
/guides/bo3-revelations: A complete For the Good of All route for 1–4 players, with Pack-a-Punch, Keeper Protector, upgraded Apothicon Servant, all three reels, photographed collection locations, rune order and the final boss. Optional masks, weapon trading, upgraded Arnies and the super Easter egg are included below. Completing the main…
/guides/bo3-nacht-der-untoten: A compact survival map with a surprisingly easy-to-miss Samantha hunt. This Chronicles guide covers the room layout, equipment, all button and doll search locations, music and the final reward. There is no main story quest or ordinary Pack-a-Punch machine here.
/guides/bo3-verruckt: The asylum starts co-op players on opposite sides and reconnects them at power. Learn that route first, then use photographs to solve the toilet code and search all ten Samantha locations. BO3 has no full main quest or ordinary Pack-a-Punch here.
/guides/bo3-shi-no-numa: Four huts surround the main building, with random perk locations and a short photographed Samantha secret. This is the BO3 remaster: the Vanguard main quest does not apply, and there is no normal Pack-a-Punch quest.
/guides/bo3-kino-der-toten: Turn on the stage lights, link the teleporter and explore the theatre’s music, film reels and Samantha secret. There is no long main story quest on Kino. The knock helper and ten-location photograph finder are here for the parts you must remember or search.
/guides/bo3-ascension: A complete Chronicles route through power, the landers, Casimir Mechanism and the optional Samantha hunt. The main quest requires four players in an unmodified game. Solo players can still unlock Pack-a-Punch, earn monkey-round rewards and complete the side secrets.
/guides/bo3-shangri-la: A four-player time-travel quest built around communication, matching symbols and careful timing. This Chronicles guide explains every crystal, the Focusing Stone and the side rewards. The tile helper stores your match’s observations; the photographed gong notes are useful for both the main quest and Samantha.
/guides/bo3-moon: A full BO3 route from No Man’s Land to the destruction of Earth, plus Hacker uses, music, Samantha and Space Dog. The complete Chronicles quest supports 1–4 players with Richtofen in the match; the BO1 requirement to finish Call of the Dead and Shangri-La first does not apply.
/guides/bo3-origins: Build and upgrade all four elemental staffs, prepare G-Strikes and the Maxis Drone, then free Samantha. This Chronicles guide works solo or with a team and includes the shield, digging rewards, extra perk slots, free weapons, music and the BO3 doll secret. Start useful preparation early: dig during snow, collect…
/guides/bo2-tranzit: Ride the Green Run loop, build power and Pack-a-Punch, then choose Maxis or Richtofen for Tower of Babble. Play on Original. Both routes have a practical two-player method; four players make the final coordination easier. This guide covers the original BO2 Jet Gun, equipment, transport, persistent storage, music and…
/guides/bo2-bus-depot: The standalone Green Run Survival arena is a two-hit survival challenge. It has no perks, Pack-a-Punch, buildables or main Easter egg. Bus travel, the Turbine and Tower of Babble belong to TranZit; this guide covers the playable depot arena.
/guides/bo2-town: Town is available in Survival and Grief. Power is already available, Pack-a-Punch sits in the street, and the compact layout makes lava and escape routes more important than unlocking a quest. The co-op Tombstone trick below can give all six perks in Survival.
/guides/bo2-farm: Farm is the compact Green Run Survival and Grief arena around the house, barn and yard. Four perks and a Mystery Box are available, but there is no Pack-a-Punch or main quest. Manage the two buildings’ escape routes before the yard fills.
/guides/bo2-diner: Diner is BO2’s Turned bonus arena. Players alternate between the lone armed human and fast zombies hunting that human. This is a timed competitive mode, with no perk setup, Pack-a-Punch or main Easter egg. The three Diner achievements require a Public Match.
/guides/bo2-nuketown-zombies: Survive the two houses while perks and Pack-a-Punch fall from the mushroom cloud. Their arrival order is random, so a safe opening must work without early Jugger-Nog. Nuketown has three music secrets, hidden Galvaknuckles and story events, but no main quest or power switch.
/guides/bo2-die-rise: A vertical map where knowing your return route matters as much as your weapon. Build the Trample Steam and Sliquifier, use the moving perk elevators safely, then complete either High Maintenance branch. The original quest needs four players on Original; it is separate from community BO3 remakes and their added quests.
/guides/bo2-mob-of-the-dead: Use Afterlife to power Alcatraz, build the escape plane and break the cycle. Setup, the plane, Hell’s Retriever, Acid Gat, Redeemer and Golden Spork can be done solo; the Pop Goes the Weasel ending needs 2–4 players, including Albert “Weasel” Arlington, on Original difficulty. This is BO2 Mob, not BO4 Blood of the…
/guides/bo2-cell-block: Cell Block is the Grief version of Alcatraz. There is no Jugger-Nog or Afterlife, and Pack-a-Punch is inside the prison. Its five perks, traps and Cerberus reward use different rules from Mob of the Dead. No plane or Pop Goes the Weasel quest is available here.
/guides/bo2-buried: Free Arthur, set up the underground town and cross the mansion to Pack-a-Punch. Mined Games has separate Richtofen and Maxis routes; plan a four-player Original-difficulty match for either complete route. The guide includes the mine cipher, both wisps, Round Infinity, bells, sharpshooter, free perks, Arthur’s jobs…
/guides/bo2-borough: Borough contains Buried’s Grief and Turned arenas. Grief opens the town and brings Pack-a-Punch outside; Turned uses a smaller street-and-store area. Arthur, the mansion maze and Mined Games are part of full Buried, not this bonus map.
/guides/bo2-origins: Build and upgrade all four elemental staffs, prepare G-Strikes and the Maxis Drone, then free Samantha. This original Black Ops II guide works solo or with a team on Original and includes the shield, digging rewards, extra perk slots, free weapons and all three songs. The final interaction ends the match. This is…
/guides/waw-nacht-der-untoten: The original Zombies bunker: three rooms, a fixed Mystery Box and very little room for mistakes. This guide covers the layout, equipment and the music secrets available in this edition. There is no main quest or Pack-a-Punch.
/guides/waw-verruckt: World at War’s asylum starts a co-op team on opposite sides. Reconnect at power, establish a trap route and find the toilet song and small environmental secrets. This version has no main quest or Pack-a-Punch.
/guides/waw-shi-no-numa: The original swamp has four random perk huts, the Flogger and the Wunderwaffe. Learn the dry routes, telephone song and story recordings. There is no main quest or normal Pack-a-Punch in this edition.
/guides/waw-der-riese: World at War’s factory introduces the three teleporter links and Pack-a-Punch. Complete the original Fly Trap hunt, find the song jars, and explore the factory’s recordings and hidden note. The Fly Trap is a short secret, not a match-ending story quest.
/guides/bo1-nacht-der-untoten: The Black Ops remaster of the original bunker: three rooms, a fixed Mystery Box and very little room for mistakes. This guide covers the layout, equipment and the music secrets available in this edition. There is no main quest or Pack-a-Punch.
/guides/bo1-verruckt: The BO1 asylum remaster starts a co-op team on opposite sides. Reconnect at power, establish a trap route and find the toilet song and small environmental secrets. This version has no main quest or Pack-a-Punch.
/guides/bo1-shi-no-numa: The Black Ops swamp remaster has four random perk huts, the Flogger and the Wunderwaffe. Learn the dry routes, telephone song and story recordings. There is no main quest or normal Pack-a-Punch in this edition.
/guides/bo1-der-riese: The BO1 factory remaster introduces the three teleporter links and Pack-a-Punch. Complete the original Fly Trap hunt, find the song jars, and explore the factory’s recordings and hidden note. The Fly Trap is a short secret, not a match-ending story quest.
/guides/bo1-kino-der-toten: Open the theatre, link the teleporter and unlock Pack-a-Punch, then explore 115, the film reels, radios and rocket model. Original Kino has no multi-stage main Easter Egg or boss ending. Its secrets reward exploration and story audio.
/guides/bo1-five: Navigate the Pentagon’s three floors, use DEFCON for Pack-a-Punch, stop the Pentagon Thief and restore the electric traps. The original Five has a phone song and equipment secrets, but no main story Easter Egg. This guide describes BO1 rather than Classified’s extra rooms and quests.
/guides/bo1-ascension: Power, all three lunar landers, the four-player Casimir Mechanism and the original side secrets. Solo players can unlock Pack-a-Punch, earn monkey-round perks and play the music, but the unmodified main quest needs four players.
/guides/bo1-shangri-la: The original four-player Time Travel Will Tell quest, from the first eclipse to the Focusing Stone. Photographed symbols, tile locations and gong notes support the steps that need communication. Power, Pack-a-Punch, the song and monkey rewards are also available outside the main quest.
/guides/bo1-moon: The BO1 route through Cryogenic Slumber Party and Big Bang Theory. The first half works solo. The full ending needs 2–4 players, Richtofen and the saved Call of the Dead co-op and Shangri-La quest prerequisites. Check the Vril Device before investing in the full run.
/guides/bo1-call-of-the-dead: A full route through the frozen film set, with separate solo and co-op quest instructions. Learn the moving Pack-a-Punch, manage George, rescue the crew behind the door and find the song. The item finder and linked-dial solver sit beside the steps that need them.
/guides/bo1-dead-ops-arcade: The original top-down arcade mode: unlock it, learn movement and pickups, choose a Fate, and survive to the Cosmic Silverback on round 40. The mode continues after that boss. It has bonus rooms and hidden interactions rather than a conventional Zombies main Easter Egg.
/guides/iw-zombies-in-spaceland: Infinite Warfare’s original Zombies mode. Scene, symbol, colour and code observations come from your current match. /guides/iw-rave-in-the-redwoods: Infinite Warfare’s original Zombies mode. Scene, symbol, colour and code observations come from your current match. Director’s Cut changes equipment access and ending rewards; its account unlocks are separate from a new map run. Repair the boat/projector, complete two dismemberment photos and a headshot skull, then…
/guides/iw-shaolin-shuffle: Infinite Warfare’s original Zombies mode. Scene, symbol, colour and code observations come from your current match. Director’s Cut changes equipment access and ending rewards; its account unlocks are separate from a new map run. Follow Pam’s rat hunt, collect the Rat King’s eye, brain and heart, then complete their…
/guides/iw-attack-of-the-radioactive-thi: Infinite Warfare’s original Zombies mode. Scene, symbol, colour and code observations come from your current match. Director’s Cut changes equipment access and ending rewards; its account unlocks are separate from a new map run. Assemble the body, open the garage, build the bomb and produce the radio-confirmed…
/guides/iw-the-beast-from-beyond: Infinite Warfare’s original Zombies mode. Scene, symbol, colour and code observations come from your current match. Director’s Cut changes equipment access and ending rewards; its account unlocks are separate from a new map run. Restore N31L, recover four coded disks, hack the handle board and install him in the…
/guides/ww2-the-final-reich: Restore Mittelburg’s power, forge the Tesla Gun and defeat the Panzermörder. Choose Casual for Fireworks or Hardcore for Dark Reunion: the extra Tesla, sword and record routes must be finished before taking the final hilt.
/guides/ww2-groesten-haus: A compact farmhouse survival map. Shoot ten lanterns to open the Mystery Box room, then unlock upgraded weapons from that box. This map has no separate main-quest boss ending.
/guides/ww2-the-darkest-shore: Use a ranged Ripsaw to open the corpse gate, collect the Sons of Nerthus, complete three friendly-enemy rituals and sink the destroyers. The ritual and artillery branches can progress independently after the gate and fighter-plane step; final radio activation commits the squad to four boss arenas.
/guides/ww2-the-shadowed-throne: Contact the Russians, build Wunderbuss and acquire the three melee weapons to enter Barbarossa’s Refuge. Solve its four statue walls, lower the Zeppelin pod and use each of Stadtjäger’s distinct damage windows. Throwable explosives are needed to expose the Pack-a-Punch panels.
/guides/ww2-into-the-storm: Chapter 1 of the Tortured Path: reassemble and charge a windmill zombie, protect its journey and collect the Hilt before defeating the wave-10 Raketenbrenner. Follow the wave windows; an escort that dies before its carried battery turns green can ruin the hidden route.
/guides/ww2-across-the-depths: Chapter 2 of the Tortured Path: shoot nine fish in battery vision, follow the Red Herring through three charge stations and win the island/cup memory sequence to claim Pommel. Prepare before the last battery teleports the team; preserve the campaign lobby from Into the Storm.
/guides/ww2-beneath-the-ice: Chapter 3 of the Tortured Path: use three newly observed rune codes to obtain Hilt, Pommel and Blade, then forge the sword before the wave-10 Guardian. The flare and sacrificial-stone stages add runes to the wall; old clue sequences remain visible and must not be reused.
/guides/ww2-bodega-cervantes: Endless survival at the Spanish bodega. Charge the 1/5/10 batteries, win the sixteen-duck shooting gallery for the special-weapon PaP fuse and use the campaign-unlocked Sword ritual if desired.
/guides/ww2-uss-mount-olympus: Endless ship survival. Charge the 1/5/10 batteries, operate six valves for the special-weapon PaP fuse and fund all seven Sword stones after the profile’s campaign unlock.
/guides/ww2-altar-of-blood: Endless survival in Thule. Charge its 1/5/10 batteries, shoot the fixed illustrated fuse sequence, fund four stones and three Forge bowls for the campaign-unlocked Sword, and uncover Kontrollgranates with Jack-in-the-Boxes.
/guides/ww2-the-frozen-dawn: Open Thule, acquire and upgrade all four Raven Lord weapons, then face the God King. The Scythe, Hammer, Shield and Flail have independent acquisition and upgrade routes. Their final trials teach abilities required in the boss fight; the Hammer’s base pillars and upgrade apparatus are different puzzles.
/guides/aw-outbreak: Complete the Atlas facility’s four access-card puzzles, raise the squad’s security clearance and call extraction. This is Advanced Warfare Exo Zombies Outbreak; the optional no-down, melee-card ending has its own conditions.
/guides/aw-infection: Prepare Bubby’s burger, restore his power and finish Burger Town’s rocket sequence. The search atlas groups every documented meat candidate by district; only one meat piece from each district is required.
/guides/aw-carrier: Power the disposal machines, collect four tablets and breach the carrier’s vault. The fishing rewards vary, the laser maze needs preparation, and planting the final C4 ends the match.
/guides/aw-descent: Complete Reunion’s alternating puzzles and challenge rounds while handling the scheduled Oz encounters. Reception’s monitor arrangement is random; the Tidal Generator digits track overlapping actions rather than four independent buttons.
/guides/vanguard-der-anfang: Open Stalingrad’s objective routes, explore Von List’s Office and follow the short narrative bridge into Terra Maledicta. Its final dialogue is the story endpoint; continued objectives, Void survival and ordinary exfil remain available.
/guides/vanguard-terra-maledicta: Complete Eastern Desert’s objective portals to free the Decimator Shield, then release the Dark Aether Tome Page. Side dig quests have their own random rewards and the page-door order changes every game.
/guides/vanguard-shi-no-numa: Use Vanguard’s Wunderwaffe and blood vision to restore the mirror and defeat the Echo. This version’s monolith, weapon build and artifacts differ from World at War and Zombies Chronicles.
/guides/vanguard-the-archon: Restore Pack-a-Punch and complete all three trials before confronting Kortifex. Mindfulness, Resilience and Sacrifice can be completed in any order; each has different preparation and failure rules.
/guides/mw3-urzikstan: Unlock the seasonal Dark Aether portals, summon and defeat the Red Worm, and complete Urzikstan’s free-perk, chess vault and triangle Easter eggs. Jump to the activity you want, then follow its illustrated steps.
/guides/mw3-dark-aether-season-1: Al Bagra Fortress contains Bad Signal’s story route and separate ordinary/Elder contract visits. Obtain the gold Locked Diary, attune the other three relics and complete the island ritual once for personal portal access.
/guides/mw3-dark-aether-season-2: Countermeasures supplies the gold Drum and three hidden purple offerings. Attune them in Urzikstan for Sa’id City portal access; repeat visits contain Bounty, Outlast and Extractors, with random Elder schematic rewards.
/guides/mw3-dark-aether-season-3: Union’s two rune crystals lead to Taoxla and the gold Giraffe Toy. Upgrade three Urzikstan relics for Zarqwa portal access, then choose acquisitions, Elder schematics or the optional Smoke Signals boss.
/guides/mw3-unstable-rift: Activate three ammo-mod obelisks in the current Urzikstan deployment, enter the public Rift and survive its five escalating arena phases. Final completion awards Mark of the Survivor and resets crafting cooldowns; the arena’s temporary boosts are not permanent schematic unlocks.
/guides/mw3-dark-aether-season-5: Ascension’s true Entity ending supplies gold Mr. Peeks. Attune three Echo relics for the Opal Palace portal, then choose ordinary acquisitions, Elder schematics or the Elder-only Infinite Cosmos STG44 blueprint route.
/guides/cw-outbreak-ravenov: Operation Inversiya: contact Maxis, find the microfilm, infiltrate Ruka’s missile silos and defeat Legion. Start at world tier 3 or higher in Outbreak Endless. The region finder and launch-light solver work inline here and share their saved inputs with the tool pages.
/guides/cw-outbreak-excision: Follow Ravenov’s signal to Sanatorium, repair the special rover and survive the Orda exfil. Start the red-rift chain at world tier 3 or higher in Outbreak Endless. This is a separate completion from Ravenov Implications and has its own saved checklist.
/tools/bo4-blood-morse: Read the three buoy digits through the shield (Gondola, Recreation Yard, Model Industries). Enter a digit 0–9 or its five Morse pulses. The answer is the sum, encoded digit by digit.
/tools/bo3-shi-perks: Record the perk found at each hut. Undiscovered huts stay unknown.
/tools/bo4-blood-powerhouse: Tap the flashing Building 64 panels on the room map. Remember the final steady lights, then match their observed monitor replacements.
/tools/bo4-voyage-clocks: Match the drawn triangle to its clock. Get exact minute/hour controls and target pointers.
/tools/bo4-voyage-outlets: Record which location sparks with each element. The pictured route puts your randomized outlets in the required trial order: Poison → Water → Electric → Fire.
/tools/bo4-voyage-sky: Record the Cargo Hold model’s eight flashing bodies and leave Sun last. Use the photographed destinations to follow your randomized order, one orb at a time.
/tools/bo4-ix-ra: Tap the actual glyphs as they flash on the obelisk. The ordered cards show which enemy to kill next. Record a fresh display for each attempt; ordinary zombies are not sequence targets.
/tools/bo4-ancient-hands: Search the Oracle’s phrase to find the exact landmark and its photograph. Select the matching clue while travelling to the hand.
/tools/bo4-ancient-tribute: Enter claimed reward counts across the whole team. A tier still waiting at the pillars is not claimed. The flame needs 9 points for every player in the match.
/tools/bo4-dead-of-the-night-alistair: Select the observed shape under each color. The enlarged glyphs are taken from actual gameplay screenshots; their display color is only a reference. Match shape and your recorded color at the Library case.
/tools/bo4-dead-of-the-night-zodiac: Choose the three shapes you actually see, record all three scratch groups in each area, and receive the telescope entry order. Blank means unread; zero means inspected and absent. Clear and reread clues after a failed input.
/tools/bo4-dead-of-the-night-stake: Record the tree shapes left to right while facing the lantern. Then record the shape visible at each Gardens stone. The helper gives the shooting route only after both observations contain all four different shapes.
/tools/bo4-classified-codes: Save the four codes from your match beside their identifying photographs. The entry strip keeps them in the required order: Shi No Numa, Der Riese, Shangri-La, Kino.
/tools/bo4-alpha-clocks: Record the five TV clues in broadcast order. See each target clock face and room, then identify the unassigned clock and convert its observed time to Rushmore’s four-digit code.
/tools/bo4-alpha-rushmore: Record all personnel codes before entering 7626 → Sawyer → McCain → Pernell. Painting codes are a later, separate batch. Optional bonus codes have their own limits.
/tools/bo4-tag-riddles: Search a few words from the spoken clue, choose Offering or Seal, then select the matching photo. Each result gives the exact landmark and action. Your selected clue stays saved.
/tools/bo6-terminus-lab: Match the three X/Y/Z notes to verified symbol images. The helper shows the three terminal entries and every calculation, including the final absolute value.
/tools/bo6-liberty-strauss: Choose the counter reading at each photographed projector to see its required lamp color. Read each location separately; the projector color is the inverse of the counter.
/tools/bo6-citadelle-raven: Choose your actual antiquity and see the exact element and zodiac images to align at the bottom pointer.
/tools/bo6-citadelle-symbols: Record six bottle runes using actual screenshot glyphs. Switch to four book pages to match trap eyes and save their observed locations.
/tools/bo6-tomb-symbols: Select the three photographed rock glyphs in your match. See the matching gateway positions, verify the safe entrance and keep the escort instructions close.
/tools/bo6-shattered-cipher: Choose the printed protocol and copy its complete letter clusters from your current board. See every letter-to-count conversion before entering the cell code.
/tools/bo6-reckoning-element: Record the ordered monitor words, or just their initials. Confirm whether one or two monitors are active; the helper returns the atomic number with its required leading zeros.
/tools/bo6-reckoning-files: Select exactly the four belongings in this match’s folders. See their real reference photos, chronological order and the resulting four-digit computer code.
/tools/cw-die-variants: Match the chamber port to its real photograph. Reveal its weapon, upgrade route and prerequisites.
/tools/cw-firebase-darts: Tap the computer’s three stopped sectors in order. Get the real dartboard numbers and final bullseye.
/tools/cw-mauer-safe: Find each number with the nine clue photographs. Keep the three values in fixed room order.
/tools/cw-forsaken-tvs: Record the real colored screens for each 4, 8 and 12-flash stage, then follow your order one shot at a time.
/tools/cw-outbreak-regions: Choose your quest, region and objective for annotated maps, object photographs and availability checks.
/tools/cw-outbreak-launch: Read the three small indicator lights below each A, B and D key switch. Green left is first, middle second, right third.
/tools/bo3-shadows-glyphs: Match the three red symbols seen through train windows. Select them from the sword wall below; the wall needs the collected set, not a special input order.
/tools/bo3-de-void: Record the three spoken names, then inspect those knights and select the symbol each actually reveals. Name-to-symbol pairings change every match.
/tools/bo3-de-terminals: Keep the safe’s top-to-bottom code separate from the four-screen memory boards. At each station, record the small screens from left to right, then match the requested symbol.
/tools/bo3-zetsubou-plants: Choose what you need to grow. Find the right water in the photos, follow the three-round recipe, then record what you did in your match.
/tools/bo3-gorod-valves: Find the green light and the pink cylinder. Set the other five valves as shown; leave the cylinder valve untouched. Restart the Hatchery generator if airflow expires.
/tools/bo3-gorod-bombs: Ignore SOPHIA’s initial fast shuffle. Record the six deliberate flashes in order, then defuse in exactly that order. Wrong input or timeout can end the run.
/tools/bo3-revelations-runes: Read your scoreboard’s four collected runes from left to right as 1–4. Record which position matches each page of the book. Use your own scoreboard, not the example photograph.
/tools/bo3-revelations-collections: Choose your current collection and region for exact photographs, sightlines and the required action.
/tools/bo3-nacht-secrets: Choose the step you are working on, narrow the locations and select any photograph to enlarge it.
/tools/bo3-verruckt-dolls: Choose the step you are working on, narrow the locations and select any photograph to enlarge it.
/tools/bo3-kino-dolls: Choose the step you are working on, narrow the locations and select any photograph to enlarge it.
/tools/bo3-ascension-dolls: Choose the step you are working on, narrow the locations and select any photograph to enlarge it.
/tools/bo3-moon-labs: Choose the step you are working on, narrow the locations and select any photograph to enlarge it.
/tools/bo3-origins-locations: Choose the step you are working on, narrow the locations and select any photograph to enlarge it.
/tools/bo3-origins-ice: Select the pattern on the blue tablet. Shoot the matching ceiling rune with the Ice Staff, then read the next tablet.
/tools/bo3-origins-fire: After lighting the Crazy Place cauldrons, select the four glowing church patterns. The result tells you which basement torches to shoot.
/tools/bo3-moon-simon: Facing the four outside computers, their order is Red, Green, Blue, Yellow from left to right. Tap what flashes, then use the numbered result in-game.
/tools/bo3-kino-knocks: Listen to three groups at the blue Alley door. Record their counts, repeat them with melee hits, then listen for a new pattern. You must answer three different patterns.
/tools/bo3-shang-tiles: Record the symbols revealed by your floor tiles. Give tiles your own landmark names so teammates can find the same pair; their positions change each match.
/tools/bo3-shang-gongs: Test the eight photographed gongs and record the four that do not turn the crystals red. Wrong gongs reset the ringing, not which four are correct.
/tools/bo2-die-rise-mahjong: Match each pictured shape to the colour seen in your match. A number and direction with the same colour tell you which tower leg to strike.
/tools/bo2-buried-signs: Match the first two shapes on each lantern-code line. Preserve the red stroke’s position, especially for Bone Orchard and Consumption Cross.
/tools/bo2-buried-levers: Flip all four levers, then record which colours sparked. Each spark confirms that lever’s position; a dark lever rules that position out. Leave the maze together before the next attempt.
/tools/bo2-buried-bells: First test the bells with your team and map each one to its light. During the sequence, tap the lit bulb for an immediate room-and-bell callout.
/tools/bo2-origins-ice: Select the pattern on the blue tablet. Shoot the matching ceiling rune with the Ice Staff, then read the next tablet.
/tools/bo2-origins-fire: After lighting the Crazy Place cauldrons, select the four glowing church patterns. The result tells you which basement torches to shoot.
/tools/bo1-cotd-dials: Co-op quest only. Enter the four digits currently visible in your lighthouse. The answer accounts for the neighbouring dials that move with each turn.
/tools/bo1-cotd-locations: Choose what you are looking for, narrow by area and select a photograph to enlarge it. Use the instructions for the current step before interacting.
/tools/bo1-shang-locations: Choose what you are looking for, narrow by area and select a photograph to enlarge it. Use the instructions for the current step before interacting.
/tools/bo1-moon-labs: Choose what you are looking for, narrow by area and select a photograph to enlarge it. Use the instructions for the current step before interacting.
/tools/bo1-shang-tiles: Record the symbols revealed by your floor tiles. Give tiles your own landmark names so teammates can find the same pair; their positions change each match.
/tools/bo1-shang-gongs: Test the eight photographed gongs and record the four that do not turn the crystals red. Wrong gongs reset the ringing, not which four are correct.
/tools/bo1-moon-simon: Facing the four outside computers, their order is Red, Green, Blue, Yellow from left to right. Tap what flashes, then use the numbered result in-game.
/tools/iw-spaceland-speakers: Number the four physical speakers with the photograph. Record their colours from this match, then record the UFO flashes. Repetitions count.
/tools/iw-spaceland-souvenirs: Choose the coins you have. Any insertion order makes the same souvenir; Weapons of Rock bonus parts require their named station.
/tools/iw-shaolin-morse: Record three digit groups. Use . for short, - for long, and a space or / between five-pulse digits. Let the in-game call hang up before collecting the poster.
/tools/iw-shaolin-word: Use confirmed letters only. A positional mask accepts _ for unknown. Rejected letters apply to the current word; a failed attempt may choose another word.
/tools/iw-attack-chemistry: Confirm O in every colour, record the TV bands, select the radio’s positively endorsed final compound, and read each diamond in the calculated filter. The chart is by RayPoopertonIII.
/tools/iw-attack-codes: The TV Studio’s film reels show the five life-ray digits (floor reel is third). Keep that order, its reversal and the later four-digit safe code separate.
/tools/iw-attack-skull-hop: Translate the four actual glyphs using the alphabet, in physical order from Slappy Taffy toward the Ice Cream Parlour. The solver uses positive positional offsets and wraps zero to Z.
/tools/iw-beast-disks: Select the four symbols photographed on your disks. All matching rows are checked. Do not reverse this chart using an older right-to-left reference.
/tools/iw-beast-handles: Record the initial 4×4 board. Freeze the snapshot, then mark only initially horizontal handles as flipped. Make a fresh pass if handles remain horizontal; this is an observation recorder.
/tools/iw-beast-queens: Orient the board to the photograph. Lock the existing queen, add any confirmed placements, then use a completion that avoids shared columns and diagonals.
/tools/ww2-final-reich-grid: Read the four columns left to right; box locations stay fixed, colours come from your match.
/tools/ww2-final-reich-voice: Match each painting to the actual bird on the machine. Green-flash groups belong to the separate hardcore record sequence.
/tools/ww2-darkest-artillery: Keep the six fuse characters independent from the moving-ship aiming examples.
/tools/ww2-shadowed-radio: Choose the pinned region and the code printed on the Main Street radio.
/tools/ww2-shadowed-statues: Walls are counterclockwise from the three-statue wall left of the stairs. Down means facing you. Record observations before shooting.
/tools/ww2-shadowed-safe: Count each active clown until it stops accepting kills, then confirm. Store activation order even if a location repeats.
/tools/ww2-shadowed-axe: Short beep = dot, long beep = dash. Separate the two five-signal digits with a space or /. Keep the etched tuning frequencies separate.
/tools/ww2-frozen-hammer: Four separate pillars; A is top and D is bottom. Front points toward the bowl where the Hammer appeared. The upgrade apparatus has different rules.
/tools/ww2-frozen-shield: Record first, second and third activation, including which pool produced each of the seven pictured patterns.
/tools/ww2-frozen-orrery: Record targets as seen on the Cypher Room wall, using the top-of-reference Schnellblitz landmark for orientation. This records positions; it cannot time moving orbs.
/tools/ww2-tortured-runes: Keep fresh sequences after each inserted rune. Describe the observed shapes or enter numbered wall positions. Old clues remain visible.
/tools/ww2-shadowed-hangman: Filter all seven reviewed reward words; unknown positions stay _ and confirmed wrong letters eliminate words.
/tools/aw-descent-simon: Arrange the four monitors from left to right as seen at Reception. Record each flash, including repeats; replay the resulting screen positions. Clear flashes between sequences while keeping the monitor arrangement.
/tools/aw-descent-numbers: Read target and current rows left to right. The first digit counts zombies hit, not slam activations. Slams, jumps and kills can overlap; reread the current row after combat. Wall-ammunition purchases do not count.
/tools/vanguard-terra-pages: Confirm positions only when a page stays attached. For a rejection, choose the entire accepted prefix followed by the failed next position. A wrong placement resets the door; replay what you have learned. Keep this notebook until a new game.
/tools/vanguard-shi-no-numa-cipher: Record each paper and assign its target ring from your wheel observation. Each plate cell pairs a paper symbol on the left with the actual wheel marking on the right. Names below are memory labels; do not enter the Chinese paper character on the wheel.
/tools/vanguard-archon-runes: Choose the 3-, 4- or 5-symbol preparation round. Give each observed symbol a memorable name and add its ground landmark. Lock the record before traversing. A website label does not identify an unobserved glyph or equip an artifact.
/tools/mw3-red-worm-photos: Select the four photographs on your current clue board to locate their USB consoles on the map.
/tools/mw3-rune-portals: Choose an Urzikstan destination to see the three runes to shoot, in order. Find every published entrance on the map.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#quick-step-p: Interact ingredients top→bottom → add your blood (lockdown, heal via Gauntlet kills) → fill serum with zombie souls → Serum.
Freeze Ashwood clock tower with DG-2 Turret → shoot clock face with Gauntlet → purple charges (3 per round, 1 per frozen face).
Find 4 ritual items (Tasty-Face, Junior's Fun-Face, Pa's Pigsticker, Ma's Chalice) → place on glowing circles → defend lockdown.
Shoot projector (purple) → 4 images = film reel order → shoot reels in order (wrong = jumpscare, next round retry).
Klaus blows the horn → red orbs with white mist at 4 locations: Monolith Forest, Collapsed Tower, Grounded Ship, Lost Cabins (3 each) — collect by driving over them (timed).
Defeat → final cinematic. Continue the game! Then interact with the Mysterious Object at Blackwater Lake to unlock Relics.
/guides/astra-malorum#quick-step-phase-1: Starting at Round 10, follow O.S.C.A.R. until it calls out three planets. Convert planets to numbers by their distance from the Sun (Mercury = 1, Neptune = 8).
/guides/astra-malorum#quick-step-phase-2: Use the Observatory Dome telescope (requires trap activation or LGM-1) to find Mars coordinates (4-digit code).
In Archive of Orbis, match the three busts to the counted book titles from their shelves (do this at round start for time).
Collect three planet notes (directions + planet): Luminarium desk, Machina Astralis table, Archive of Orbis table.
Return to Machina Astralis, interact with the brain to reboot the portal, defend against O.S.C.A.R.; you will be sent to Mars.
/guides/astra-malorum#quick-step-phase-3: Each round, play the machine sound to spot the ascendant eye; while it flies, shoot pylons: Back Right > Back Left > Front Right > Front Left > temple pylon above the machine. Grab the eye when it dives.
Back in Observatory Dome, read the organ screen: it shows the five symbols in order with one missing (denoted by wavy lines). Note the missing symbol and its position.
Return to Mars and interact with the pillars in that exact order, inserting the missing symbol where indicated.
/guides/astra-malorum#quick-step-boss-co: Kill zombies to charge the Tesla coils. Activate the machine to fire at Caltheris; repeat on the opposite side while avoiding lasers and lava.
/guides/astra-malorum#quick-step-boss-ne: In the final phase, avoid the purple pools, faster movement and stronger slam. Deplete her remaining health to finish the fight.
/guides/paradox-junction#quick-step-phas: Normal Shoot Yellow backyard’s swing; take its seat. Destroyed RC-XD race → Chalk → return seat and chalk to the swing → Twins scene.
Destroyed Seeds: Yellow garage’s red toolbox. Normal Plant left of Trinity Ave PaP and feed the tree souls with either Blundergat.
Destroyed Throw 3 Combat Axes at the tree for firewood. Normal Place it in Yellow House’s fireplace and light with a Molotov.
Destroyed Stand on Trinity Ave’s X until it stays blue. Normal Watch the scene; hop 1→12→1, avoiding smoke (30s retry wait).
Destroyed Turn the Green backyard Piano Teacher with Brain Rot/Psych. Follow it indoors, then quickly teleport to Normal for its piano scene.
Destroyed Kill 3 floating backyard zombies. Normal Trinity Ave ball trial: kill airborne zombies before the ball lands. Feed the music sheet souls with Sundergat; escort to piano.
Destroyed Shoot the red ball to Green backyard’s X. Normal Start Four Square; melee the ball between squares, allowing just one bounce per square, until time ends.
P1: 3 goo piles (Trinity/Yellow/Green House) → fill cysts with souls → clear goo → defend Concentration Field on each revealed object → damage orange spots; redirect tornadoes with Molotovs.
/guides/totenreich#quick-step-phase-1-ol: Obtain the Jotunn Star (wonder weapon). In Cursed Mode, grab the Wrestler's Belt magazine in the lighthouse before taking the weapon.
/guides/totenreich#quick-step-phase-2-ol: Core Foundry Ascender (Molotov) → console: calibrate Amplitude + Frequency → fire both sets → Wunderbarrage Controller.
/guides/totenreich#quick-step-phase-3-ol: Clear debris (Wunderbarrage) → Machine Workshop → record the six existing tubes and place three Uranium tubes to keep the gauge in its target range → Atomkraft Core.
/guides/totenreich#quick-step-phase-4-ol: Sunstone in Eidskallen Stave Church center → giant arrow circle → shoot rune wood piles in order (arrow count = order).
/guides/totenreich#quick-step-phase-5-ol: Tyr disabled → Gjallarfrost heads: grenade in mouth or Jotunn Star ranged to stun → destroy; dodge ice shard runes, shoot random weak spots.
/guides/kowakujo#quick-step-phase-4-ol-3: Clock Puzzle: storage clock ×4 → assault wave → read Japanese numbers → allocate up to two flags per area → final evidence.
/guides/kowakujo#quick-step-phase-5-ol-3: Paintings 1–5: match the evidence using the trap ghost, Death Records, Poison Compendium and fourth painting’s background.
/guides/kowakujo#quick-step-phase-6-ol-2: Expel the Onryo: incense bowls → glowing orb → Shogun's Sanctum → World Seed → Onryo fight (shoot its masks to break immunity).
/guides/rex-infernus#quick-step-setup-cl: Unlock Pack-a-Punch and collect the Void Claw. Follow the Warden’s Blight route through the Fracture and recover its three parts.
/guides/rex-infernus#quick-step-setup-bl: Dravakar Sanctuary: match the wall riddle to its lever pulls, confirm at the center pillar and forge Warden’s Blight.
/guides/rex-infernus#quick-step-setup-ta: Shoot the basketball in the house roof. Record four symbols across the next four rounds; shoot them in that order on an Exfil round. Exfil to Her House, retrieve the Eye of the Forge and upgrade a Void Claw pedestal.
/guides/rex-infernus#quick-step-phase-1-: Veytharion's Sanctuary: collect the 4 cubes (pillar by GobbleGum, 2 windows in Mule Kick room, near Void Claw pedestal).
Left opening bottom→top: Fire, Hand, Water, Leaf. Shuffle to the right opening → Water, Leaf, Hand, Fire. Fire must never touch Leaf/Water; slide empties if a round ends.
Shoot/melee the circle to move the slide. Reward: swirling pool + Random Perk. Interacting with the pool triggers rain the next round (needed for every temple cleansing).
/guides/rex-infernus#quick-step-phase-2-: Purple orb → Pack-a-Punch → surge, then quickly interact the ground Pull Switch next to Deadshot Daiquiri at the Nexus Core bottom.
/guides/rex-infernus#quick-step-phase-3-: Per temple: quest item → cauldron + Astral Flame shot → attach floater to a zombie → its symbol matches a Titan Trap shackle (Caltheris / Veytharion Passage) → trap it.
Tile mini-action → reflector: Dravakar re-plate several times · Nyxara prone · Caltheris aim 30 s · Veytharion keep jumping.
Purple orb under the face + Warden's Blight lift → purple eyes → rain + Astral Flame to the face point = cleansed.

Items: Dravakar — Blacksmith's Hammer (Shatter Blast shields) · Nyxara — Ancient Scroll (Shadow Rift in forest) · Caltheris — Shimmering Thread (purple orbs) · Veytharion — Woven Sash (rain; Spira / Ruinas / Aranea Insula).
/guides/rex-infernus#quick-step-phase-4-: Immune: destroy Shadow Souls (Light Mend) → P2: destroy Stingers (Cryofreeze) or they trigger a wipe; dodge stun circles.
Intermediate room: survive or kill the HVT. P3: armor-providing Shadow Souls + skulls. P4: more skulls before each stun.
/guides/cw-die-maschine#quick-step-varia: Electric: lower accelerator portal → suck one crystal → shoot crate; repeat for Crash Site, Pond and Penthouse.
/guides/cw-forsaken#quick-step-parts-3: Dead Wire by Arcade Grand Prix → pay 2,000 → ARC-XD through TV Store vent → detonate behind shelf → collect monitor.
/guides/bo4-tag-der-toten#quick-step-orb: Heat both stones at Boathouse → stay dry → one hot stone + one Decontamination-cooled stone into Human Infusion.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#ashes-get-a: Pick up a Fumigator before beginning the crystal portion. Known spawns include the early map areas and Vandorn Farm.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#ashes-find-: Search the Fog and Ashwood for The Twins. Look near the boat, behind the cabins between Blackwater Lake and Ashwood, or near the Ashwood zipline. Approach them. They disappear and relocate to the barn at Vandorn Farm.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#ashes-knock: Acquire the Necrofluid Gauntlet. At Vandorn Farm, locate the smoking toy box on the windmill watched by The Twins. Shoot it with the Wonder Weapon to knock it down.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#ashes-open-: Directly hit the fallen box with Dark Flare to open it.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#ashes-activ: Go into the Fog between Janus Towers Plaza and Blackwater Lake. Shoot the three small purple crystals attached to the large rocks, then use the Fumigator on each one.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#ashes-open-: After all three crystals are activated, a meteor lands at Blackwater Lake. Fumigate the meteor. If it does not open immediately, progress the round and return.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#ashes-retur: Take the item from the meteor back to Vandorn Farm and place it inside the toy box. The box opens and gives you the miniature Ol' Tessie toy.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#ashes-exfil: Pick up Tessie and successfully Exfil. The toy can be seen entering the Exfil portal when the completion registers.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#astra-set-u: Activate Pack-a-Punch and power up the telescope by shooting its five panels. Complete the DG-2 turret side Easter Egg and install the turret on Ol' Tessie.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#astra-move-: Find the floating toy box outside the Luminarium area. Use explosives to move the box toward spawn until it reaches the area near Tessie.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#astra-pull-: Throw a Kazimir underneath the floating box to pull it down.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#astra-kill-: Bring O.S.C.A.R. into the area around the toy box. Destroy his drone and kill him using the DG-2 turret. The toy box opens.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#astra-revea: Complete the slowed-time grandfather-clock side Easter Egg. Look through the telescope during the effect to reveal the UFO.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#astra-reach: Progress the Astra Malorum Main Quest until Mars becomes accessible.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#astra-summo: Find the glowing objects near the Ascendant Eye area and activate them with Shock Charges. The UFO appears overhead.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#astra-compl: Complete the lantern side Easter Egg and collect the upgraded wisps.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#astra-solve: The UFO flashes a sequence corresponding to suspended objects around Mars. Possible objects include a flamingo, lava lamp, space suit, and toilet. Use the wisps to activate the correct objects. You can also activate all of them if you do not want to decode the sequence.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#astra-colle: The final object leaves behind a small alien. Bring it back to the toy box and collect the Caltheris toy.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#astra-exfil: Successfully Exfil with the Caltheris toy to bank the Astra completion.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#paradox-act: Open Pack-a-Punch before beginning the new puzzle.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#paradox-int: In Cleantown, find the chalk drawing of a chest on the garage door between the houses near spawn. Interact with it.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#paradox-use: Go upstairs in the yellow house and find the chalk question mark beside the bookshelf. Throw a Psyche Grenade at it and interact.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#paradox-ret: Interact with the chalk chest again to begin the Mrs. Peeks part hunt.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#paradox-fin: Collect the six pieces scattered around Nukedtown. Some can be picked up directly, while others need to be shot down.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#paradox-reb: Take all six parts to the top of the bus and rebuild Mrs. Peeks.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#paradox-com: Collect the spawned power-ups before the timer expires. Failed attempts can be retried on later rounds.
Take the reward from the challenge and place it into the toy box.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#paradox-exf: Collect the Twins dolls and successfully Exfil.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#kowakujo-tu: Open the map until power and Pack-a-Punch are available.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#kowakujo-pu: Use the pink blossom whirlwind inside the castle to pull the toy box down from above Pack-a-Punch.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#kowakujo-fo: Follow the bird between the Castle, Kitchen and Staging Area. Melee the relevant tree at each stop and wait for the bird to move before continuing.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#kowakujo-ac: Bring the final pink blossom whirlwind underneath the large central sakura tree. Use it between the Mystery Box and the rock used by Onryo during the first boss encounter.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#kowakujo-co: The bird drops an origami swan. Pick it up and deliver it to the toy box.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#kowakujo-ex: Collect the resulting toy and successfully Exfil to bank the Kowakujō completion.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#totenreich-: Go behind Ms. Loven's Antique Shop and look into the water for a small iceberg. This iceberg contains the Totenreich toy box.
Activate Wildfire and use the nearest fishing spot. The fishing rod glows when the correct interaction is active. Reel in the iceberg to bring the frozen box onto land.
Use fire damage to defrost the iceberg and reveal the toy box. Wildfire, a Molotov, or another suitable fire source can be used.

Go toward the graveyard outside the playable area near the Wonder Weapon route. A named elite enemy called King Draugvald the Undying appears outside the map. Once he notices you, he begins following you.

Progress far enough through the lighthouse route to access its elevated parkour area. The hidden Silent Heir crossbow is on the lighthouse structure near the broken ledge above the GobbleGum machine. You may need to go prone near the gap to see the pickup prompt.
Bring the King into a safe area and damage him. You can weaken him using another weapon, but use the Silent Heir to finish the kill.
King Draugvald drops his crown when killed correctly. Pick it up and return to the frozen toy box.
Place the crown into the toy box. The box rewards you with the Guardian toy.
Pick up the Guardian and successfully Exfil.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#rex-upgrade: Progress Rex Infernus far enough to obtain the upgraded grapple, commonly referred to as the Void Talon.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#rex-grapple: Go toward the bridge at the entrance to Nyxara Temple. A floating lock appears underneath the bridge. Grapple it with the upgraded grapple to begin the Super EE minigame.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#rex-complet: Special piñatas appear around Rex Infernus. Grappling a piñata activates a nearby soul-box challenge. Each has an extra condition rather than simply requiring normal kills. For example, one challenge near Juggernog requires kills while jumping. Complete the active challenges until the Warden toy becomes available.
/guides/bo7-super-easter-egg#rex-collect: Finish the Rex minigame and collect the Warden action figure. Return to Her House and place it with the five toys already on the shelf.

/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:janus: Starting plaza: find Ol' Tessie, the Server Room and the Stabilizer Chip encounter.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:server: Room containing Quick Revive. Collect T.E.D.D.'s head, free Stun Grenade and the song headphones here. Room highlight uses the verified nearby perk position.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:farm: Farm complex with Farmhouse, Barn, Cellar and Garage. Individual buildings have separate area markers.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:farmhous: Stamin-Up building: dining clock and Pa, Tasty-Face bunk bed, red candle and the TV Twins. Search the described furniture; this is a room-area marker.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:barn: Death Perception building: power switch, hanging corpse, upstairs toy horse and Grim relic portal. Upper and lower floors share this overview.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:cellar: Underground room near the MK.78 / Arsenal. Necrofluid cube and Ma's Chalice bathtub. Marker uses the building footprint; the cellar is below it.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:farm-gar: Garage near the Armor Vest: Pa's Pigsticker ritual item. Building-area highlight.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:blackwat: Cabin, Toolshed, Boathouse and pier area.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:cabin: Speed Cola building. Find the Jar of Spores under the kitchen cabinet, projector, film reels, Hellion Horn box and interior relic portals.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:cabin-ba: Ammo Cache side of the Cabin: film reel beneath the stairs and Klaus waiting with the Hellion Horn. Approximate area around the official Ammo Cache.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:toolshed: Crafting Table building: fertilizer canister, film reel and axe-throwing trophy. Building-area highlight.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:pier: Pier and Boathouse at the lakeside north of the Cabin. Interact with the floating soul, check the overhead film reel, and find the boat-house relic portal. Approximate shore area, not an exact object pin.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:ashwood: Town center between the northern and southern travel loops.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:sheriff: Akita wall-buy building by Market Square. Put the Stabilizer Chip in the cell panel and revive Klaus. Building area, not the panel position.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:ruby: Jugger-Nog building. Stun Grenade shelf, red candle and song/side quest items are inside. Building area.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:ruby-all: Alley near the X9 Maverick wall-buy. Deliver the three keys to the Seal of Sorrow. Approximate alley area.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:judgemen: VS Recon wall-buy area. Song headphones and fertilizer canister are in this square.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:market: Vulture Aid area and Ashwood power-switch side.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:ash-gara: Drive Ol' Tessie to the garage door to install upgrades. Ashwood building-area guidance; the exact garage-door coordinate has not been surveyed.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:tailor: Town shop containing the mirror for Powder of the Forgotten. Approximate western-shop area; exact mirror position not surveyed.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:ash-cloc: Aim upwards at the clock tower above Ashwood. Freeze its faces using the DG-2 turret, then obtain purple Gauntlet charges. This ground-area highlight does not show the floating tower height.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:cosmodro: Cosmodrome complex: Yuri's Lab, Support Systems, Control Room and the launch area.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:lab: Laboratory in the cosmodrome building complex. Read the chalkboard, add ingredients, then defend the Serum. Approximate building area, not the worktable coordinate.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:control: Room near the Armor Vest: radar-dish challenge and pigpen / number monitors. The dishes are above/outside the room.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:support: Crafting Table building: send Klaus to the panel, stand in the scanner and collect the Aether Barrel. Room-area highlight.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:launch: Flame Trench / launch area, including the yellow relic trial portals. Follow the described launch-pad or Exfil-cabin landmark; exact portal positions not surveyed.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:exit: Service area with Reba's Diner, McDougal's Service Station and the shipping container.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:diner: Elemental Pop building: Cook zombie, freezer, Abomination carcass, free Tomahawk and waitress cash register. Room-area highlight.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:service: Deadshot Daiquiri building: shoot the clock and send Klaus to the mechanic in the garage. Room-area highlight.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:trucker: Cargo container opposite the Service Station. Ram it with Tessie to revive the trucker. Approximate roadside area; exact container not surveyed.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:monolith: Northwestern fog road between Janus Towers and Blackwater Lake. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:collapse: Northeastern fog road between Janus Towers and Vandorn Farm. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:ship: Ship on the road between Vandorn Farm and Ashwood. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:lost-cab: Cabins on the road between Blackwater Lake and Ashwood. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:rocket: Fog road between Ashwood and Zarya Cosmodrome. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:plane: Southern fog road between Zarya Cosmodrome and Exit 115. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:orda: Southwestern fog road between Exit 115 and Ashwood. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.
/guides/ashes-of-the-damned#map:sepulche: Detached temple visible west of Blackwater Lake. This is the boss destination, not a driving entrance; completing the soul-orb collection teleports you inside. Interior combat positions are not shown.

/guides/astra-malorum#map:crash: Ol' Tessie and the starting area.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:luminarium: Brain jar, planet page, gramophone, grandfather clock and Stellar Dissector room. Area highlight; inspect the described table, shelves or doorway.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:museum: Rock Saw display, rocket-thruster trap, records, Twins cabinets and chandelier puzzle. The highlight identifies the room, not an individual display.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:courtyard: Central outdoor courtyard between the museum and the Observatory Dome.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:machina: Main circular building: Perfusion Machine and portal defense. Upper-level model and terminal locations have separate markers.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:machina-upper: Climb to the upper level for the planet model and four-digit terminal. Overview uses the same building footprint for all floors.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:cryopod: Side room on the route towards Scholar's Way: open the cryopod and collect the brain. Approximate room highlight; room is not separately labelled in the official atlas.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:archive: Library adjoining Machina Astralis, near Stamin-Up. Busts, bookshelves, planet page and Neptune ladder are in this room.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:dome: Telescope, organ and lift terminal. The precise valve and terminal positions are not marked; search the room using the step instructions.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:rim: Outer path from the Luminarium towards the Observatory Dome, including the lower Ammo Cache area and the route past Wisp Tea.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:veilwalk: Outer walkway east of the Observatory Dome, continuing to Machina Astralis.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:scholar: Passage between Museum Infinitum and the side room of Machina Astralis.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:mars-center: Pick up the brain jar here. Arena pillars, gut piles and the moving Ascendant Eye are represented as an area; their exact positions are not surveyed.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:mars-machine: Place the brain jar in the machine, create the return portal, play music and start Caltheris. Temple area near the community-map portal coordinate.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:mars-eye: Place the Ascendant Eye in the device on the right, facing the distant pylons away from the temple. This is the southern arena corner on the top-down map. Approximate device area.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:mars-left: Opposite arena corner used during the boss sequence. Approximate area; look for the charged coil during the fight.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:mars-back-righ: First off-map pylon in the Ascendant Eye sequence. Relative position only.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:mars-back-left: Second off-map pylon in the Ascendant Eye sequence. Relative position only.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:mars-front-rig: Third off-map pylon in the Ascendant Eye sequence. Relative position only.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:mars-front-lef: Fourth off-map pylon in the Ascendant Eye sequence. Relative position only.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:mars-temple: Turn back towards the temple and shoot the pylon above it last, then repeatedly to keep the music playing while collecting the Ascendant Eye. Height is not shown.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:mars-ammo: Ammo Cache position from the community tactical map.
/guides/astra-malorum#map:mars-armor: Armor Wall Buy position from the community tactical map.

/guides/aw-carrier#map:suit: The creator places the Exo station in Cargo. Collect an Exo Suit and open the Armory, Cargo Deck, Lift, Moon Pool, Hangar, Bio Lab and Gun Deck routes needed below. Identify upgrade stations and the Armory Teleport Grenade wallbuy. Ordinary bomb-defusal rounds are map objectives, separate from the tablet sequence.…
/guides/aw-carrier#map:chompy: Activate Chompy in Cargo Deck. As its wall door opens, throw a Teleport Grenade into the small room before the door closes. Once inside, activate the generator; the room soon returns you to the deck. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
/guides/aw-carrier#map:disposal: The generator activates Weapon Disposal and the special Grenade Disposal puzzle in the Armory. Confirm their lights/power before spending weapons or beginning the icon sequence. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
/guides/aw-carrier#map:vault: Take the tablet from the right-hand slot and deposit it at the Gun Deck vault door. If it will not accept the tablet, wait for Oz’s dialogue to finish and interact again. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
/guides/aw-carrier#map:fishing: Feed Weapon Disposal distinct weapons; repeating a weapon already submitted does not advance its item payout. Its early rewards are the bottle, reel, line and hook. Install each rod part on the Gun Deck rod immediately before claiming another: a new part replaces an uninstalled held part. Region-level overlay only:…
/guides/aw-carrier#map:teleporter: Kill teleporting zombies or dogs and collect their telefrag pieces promptly; floor drops expire. Carry one piece at a time and install it at the inactive Bio Lab teleporter. After 20 installed pieces the teleporter is usable. Their availability increases later in the match; wait for the relevant enemies instead of…
/guides/aw-carrier#map:cage: Install the lever in the Moon Pool electrical box beside the printer. Kill zombies around the three floor grates until their blood attracts the swimming shark. When it passes beneath the central opening, pay the box’s 1,000-credit activation and jump onto the cage to descend. Region-level overlay only: consult the…
/guides/aw-carrier#map:locker: Inspect Captain DJ’s locker near Hangar Exo Medic to hear the eye-scanner clue. After this, a pair of treasure drones can spawn over later rounds. Shoot the EMPTY drone to recover its lever; a normal filled loot drone does not provide this quest item. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the…

/guides/aw-descent#map:area-reception: Advanced Warfare · Exo Zombies. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Collect Galleria Exo Suit; open Lounge, Reception and Tidal Generator.
/guides/aw-descent#map:area-hall: Advanced Warfare · Exo Zombies. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Activate the Concierge, Galleria aquarium and high Tidal Generator stingrays.
/guides/aw-descent#map:area-spa: Advanced Warfare · Exo Zombies. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Collect Galleria Exo Suit; open Lounge, Reception and Tidal Generator.
/guides/aw-descent#map:area-annex: Advanced Warfare · Exo Zombies. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Only the documented connections are drawn; detailed object placements and unshown paths require the guide.
/guides/aw-descent#map:area-galleria: Advanced Warfare · Exo Zombies. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Collect Galleria Exo Suit; open Lounge, Reception and Tidal Generator.

/guides/aw-descent#map:area-oz: Advanced Warfare · Exo Zombies. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Prepare for Oz at rounds 5, 12/13 and 20; resume Reunion afterward.
/guides/aw-descent#map:suit: Collect an Exo Suit from Galleria and open routes to Lounge, Reception and Tidal Generator. Prepare upgrades and decontamination access. Exo Slam is specifically required for the later number panel. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
/guides/aw-descent#map:shower: Resort decontamination is in the Spa; Oz’s arena has a separate event pad. Collect an Exo Suit from Galleria and open routes to Lounge, Reception and Tidal Generator. Prepare upgrades and decontamination access. Exo Slam is specifically required for the later number panel. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide…
/guides/aw-descent#map:terminal: Shoot the three valves along Tidal Generator’s spiral staircase until each shows a BLUE lamp: left of its power generator, above the right yellow door, and right of the AMR9 wallbuy. The room halfway up the staircase opens. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current…
/guides/aw-descent#map:airlock: Hold interact at Lounge’s underwater door to depressurize it. This takes a sustained hold, but its progress persists if you leave to retrieve equipment. Obtain a Goliath suit from a supply drop; it is a random reward rather than a guaranteed round spawn. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for…
/guides/aw-descent#map:capacitor: Bring electrical enemies to the Galleria capacitor and allow their electrical hits to charge it. Other electric variants also work. Remove ordinary attackers and leave an escape route: losing Exo movement in this space can trap you. Continue until its display reads 100% and Angie confirms power diversion; use the…
/guides/aw-descent#map:simon: At Reception, interact with the glowing right-hand monitor. First record which colour occupies each physical screen from LEFT to RIGHT; the arrangement varies. Record the flashing colours in order, including repeats, and interact with their corresponding screens. A cheerful tone and power-diversion line confirm…
/guides/aw-descent#map:digits: Read the target TOP row and current BOTTOM row near the upstairs terminal. Match all four digits using the actions below. Digits wrap through 0–9; the first counts zombie hits, so a single multi-target slam can advance it several times. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and…
/guides/aw-descent#map:platforms: At spawn, cross each blue-platform pattern using Exo movement and reach its final platform. It bounces you back and changes the pattern; complete nine. A platform disappears shortly after being stood on, then returns, so pause safely when an upcoming platform is absent. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide…
/guides/aw-infection#map:area-spawn: Advanced Warfare · Exo Zombies. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Exo-boost from the spawn crate to the golden roof pan.
/guides/aw-infection#map:area-voltage: Advanced Warfare · Exo Zombies. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Get the sewer Exo Suit and open all four districts.
/guides/aw-infection#map:area-atlas: Advanced Warfare · Exo Zombies. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Get the sewer Exo Suit and open all four districts.

/guides/aw-infection#map:area-burger: Advanced Warfare · Exo Zombies. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Get the sewer Exo Suit and open all four districts.
/guides/aw-infection#map:area-burger-top: Advanced Warfare · Exo Zombies. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Take Bubby’s key and trigger Access Denied inside the rooftop burger.

Locate the sewer decontamination pad before carrying infected quest items. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

/guides/totenreich#map:eidskallen-landin: Spawn region around Quick Revive and the Riese head.
/guides/totenreich#map:eidskallen-square: Village square around Stamin-Up and the routes to the landing and hall.
/guides/totenreich#map:dry-dock: Dock area around Speed Cola, PhD Flopper and Melee Macchiato. Search the boat and buildings described by the guide.
/guides/totenreich#map:titan-crane: Crane room at the north end of Dry Dock. Use its timed button, then wall-jump to the ship bow for the chain links.
/guides/totenreich#map:machine-workshop: Upper room on the southwestern side of Dry Dock, reached by clearing the 02 Building stairs with Wunderbarrage. Contains the claw machine and upper gnome catwalk.
/guides/totenreich#map:core-foundry: Western foundry rooms, near the VS Recon wall-buy. The ARC-XD vent leads across the water to the Genetic Lab; the Ascender reaches the radio console.
/guides/totenreich#map:genetic-lab: Lab on Fishery Island, opened by sending the ARC-XD across from Core Foundry. Enter from the Pack-a-Punch side for the jars, Necrospike and Uranium cell.
/guides/totenreich#map:war-factory: Western factory building next to Core Foundry. The crate sits near the Admin room entrance.
/guides/totenreich#map:storm-bridge: Northern bridge between Tyr’s Foot and Tyr’s Shoulder. The Chilly Chunks truck and charged-core barrel are on this bridge.
/guides/totenreich#map:tyrs-foot: Northwestern foot of the giant robot. Enter Tyr here, and search nearby for the note and Dravakar Shard.
/guides/totenreich#map:tyrs-head: Tyr’s interior is drawn separately as the small circle north of Storm Bridge. The transmitter and blinking lights are on the second floor; the console launches the boss encounter.
/guides/totenreich#map:tyrs-shoulder: Northeastern shoulder of the giant robot. Upper access to Tyr and a fishing spot.
/guides/totenreich#map:fjord-road: Southern road connecting the landing to Dry Dock. Check the checkpoint near the Flammenfalle trap for the flak-round crate.
/guides/totenreich#map:fishery-island: Central island containing Juggernog and the Glocke Drop Pack-a-Punch landing.
/guides/totenreich#map:skallen-market: Market around Mule Kick. Place Chilly Chunks on the central table and search nearby houses for side-quest items.
/guides/totenreich#map:burial-grounds: Northeastern burial region and shrine, beyond the church. Use the chain links at the door and match the constellations.
/guides/totenreich#map:stave-church: Church just west of Burial Grounds, north of Skallen Market. Place the Sunstone on its central altar.
/guides/totenreich#map:blodheim-hall: Feasting hall around Vulture Aid. Its central bonfire, bear pelts and helmet displays serve several quests.
/guides/totenreich#map:lovens-antiquitie: Antiquities shop in the northwestern part of Eidskallen Square. Search its shelves for headphones and the counter for the Kneehigh Helm.
/guides/totenreich#map:beacon-island: Southeastern island with the Lighthouse, arsenal, Wunderfizz and fishing access.
/guides/totenreich#map:lighthouse: Tower on Beacon Island. Jotunn Star is in the top chamber; the Crowbar is on an interior shelf.

/guides/vanguard-der-anfang#map:area-hub: Vanguard. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Complete district portals to open the hub and earn Sacrificial Hearts.
/guides/vanguard-der-anfang#map:area-wes: Vanguard. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Only the documented connections are drawn; detailed object placements and unshown paths require the guide.
/guides/vanguard-der-anfang#map:area-apa: Vanguard. Named region on an original diagram; spacing and angles are not geographical. Open Apartments and interact with its upstairs ritual rune.
