/dmz/intel/armory#intel-weapon-insurance: An item found in the Vault Edition Deployment Kit (two) and the Legendary Advanced SERE Kit. The official posts do not explain how weapon insurance works.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-rarity-tiers: Loot rarity runs Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Ultra.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-plate-carriers: Vests decide how many armor plates you wear; eight are known, from the 1-Plate Armor Vest to the Tempered Armor Vest.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-backpacks: Without a backpack you get an 8-slot Basic Pack. Bigger packs add room and Secure Slots; weapon backpacks add a weapon slot.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-secure-slots: Items in a backpack's Secure Slots survive a failed exfil; everything else in the backpack is lost. Hands-on describes one slot that keeps a single item such as a key.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-radiation-gear: Protective gear required with a gas mask in the reactor; found at Fire Stations.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-tacticals: Tactical equipment in DMZ, mostly unlocked through DMZ levels.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-field-upgrades: Field Upgrades are crafted items in DMZ and do not recharge as they do in Multiplayer.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-fire-support-kil: Killstreaks are printable/lootable Fire Support items in DMZ. Known ones: UAV (Epic), Advanced UAV, Care Package (Rare), Combat Drone (Epic) and Crossfire.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-weapon-manuals: Loot and extract a weapon's Manual once to unlock buying that base weapon at the Gunsmith as often as you like. The manual is used up and pays $5,000.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-weapon-cases-and: CODMunity's map has pin types for weapon cases and safes, but no locations or contents were published before launch.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-hidden-caches: From The Ward showed hidden stashes in duffel bags under stairwells, in chem lockers and in an irradiated pond.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-supply-drops: Each completed Dynamic Operation calls in a Supply Drop whose rarity rises from Common to Uncommon to Rare within a run. Recovering lost supply drops is also a Side Op.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-encrypted-drive: The objective item in Operation Dead Man's Cache, collected from a care package.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-dreadnought-lmg: A Legendary LMG worth $16K with a 100-round box magazine, shown in Lieutenant Bale's hangar in the Dynamic Ops trailer.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-separate-weapon-: DMZ has weapon balancing separate from MP and Warzone. There is no Armor-Piercing or Stopping Power ammo Field Upgrade and no option to hide MW4 skins.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-w-m-d-manifest: A launch-day guide video shows where to find an item called the W.M.D. Manifest, probably a mission item.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-detonators: Detonators are Uncommon 3D Printer ingredients worth $200, used for the DDOS field upgrade, Smelling Salts and the Artillery Beacon. The in-game hint and guides point to military and industrial areas, such as the industrial building at the Songdo Wharf docks and the basic weapons locker in Compound Alpha.
/dmz/intel/armory#intel-k9-battery-core: Taken from robot dogs and used to power doors through fuse boxes, including the lab door in Operation Shopping Hacks and a fuse box in the prison.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-dmz-cash-a: The in-game currency for weapons, attachments, infil, MIA rescues, Lieutenant intel, bounties and more. Cash picked up in a match is only banked if you extract, while mission and Op payouts are wired to the FOB.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-bank-cap: Banked DMZ Cash is capped at $100,000 at first. Bank Upgrade I ($20,000) raises the cap to $250,000 and Bank Upgrade II ($50,000) to $500,000.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-stash-capa: The Stash starts at 40 item and 12 weapon slots. The level track adds 18 item slots at Levels 22, 45 and 70 and 6 weapon slots at Levels 35 and 60, and the 3D Printer offers more capacity upgrades.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-shared-res: DMZ Cash, Resources, Ingredients and everything in the Stash are shared by all your Active Duty Operators, so you can farm with a looting-focused Operator and equip the others.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-bounty-pay: Level rewards raise the payout for claimed bounties: +10% at Level 30, +25% at Level 40, +50% at Level 50 and +100% at Level 70.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-gunsmith-d: A 5% discount on all Gunsmith purchases unlocks at DMZ Level 25; further discounts come from the 3D Printer.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-level-unlo: Activision's full DMZ level table lists what each level from 2 to 70 unlocks, from the 3D Printer at Level 2 to extra stash space, a 100% bounty payout boost and an Advanced SERE Kit at Level 70.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-dmz-callin: DMZ has its own Calling Card mastery sets plus an Elite DMZ Mastery category.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-rewards-fo: Players who played the Modern Warfare II DMZ Beta on the same Activision account receive emblems and calling cards from DMZ Early Access (20 Oct) onward.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-campaign-c: Rewards earned through the Modern Warfare 4 Campaign can be used in DMZ once the full game launches.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-dmz-level-: DMZ has its own 1-70 level track, separate from the 1-55 player level, unlocking stations, upgrades, recipes, skins, kits, ingredients and fire support. Failed exfils still give XP.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-dmz-xp-sou: DMZ XP comes from exfils, Orders, Story Missions, Dynamic Ops, Side Ops, opening containers, kills (players worth more than AI), bosses and reviving teammates. XP is kept even on a failed exfil.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-dmz-xp-and: DMZ XP also counts toward the shared 1-55 player level, but Multiplayer and Warzone XP do not raise DMZ level.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-serpentine: Developers say a challenge similar to the Serpentine camo is planned after launch.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-king-slaye: King Slayer is a DMZ calling card earned by killing Commanders. Since the 20 Oct fix, everyone in the squad gets Commander XP and King Slayer progress, not only the player who lands the final blow.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-dmz-is-not: Unlike the 2022 DMZ, which came free alongside Warzone, MW4's DMZ is only playable by owners of Modern Warfare 4; it is part of the paid game, not a free download.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-lieutenant: Killing a Lieutenant and extracting its Dog Tags pays $25,000 into the Bank on top of the kill, and claims that Lieutenant's Boss Board card. COD Central says carrying a Lieutenant's tag reveals your position to other operators on the Tac Map.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-keep-a-cas: Infinity Ward suggests keeping a second Operator as a cash mule to raid vaults and run Dynamic Ops for money, then using that cash to rescue your main Operator.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-recommende: Activision recommends bringing a Plate Carrier, a Backpack, a weapon and a Medkit on every infil.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-balance-co: Open every container, but aim for a balanced deployment across combat, looting and objectives to hit an S-tier After Action rating.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-stay-quiet: Use melee, throwing knives or suppressed weapons to move through high-threat areas unnoticed, and break line of sight to calm enemies.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-use-the-pr: Check the 3D Printer for hints on where each Ingredient is most likely found, then plan your route around those spots.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-stack-orde: Compare your squad's DMZ Orders with the chosen Story Mission, since objectives can often be completed together.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-farm-in-fr: Free Roam suits farming printer ingredients and hunting Wanted players.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-build-guns: Experienced players can carry an extra built weapon in a Weapon Backpack and drop it for a teammate in Hajin.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-bring-nvgs: The Heavenly Luck Casino and the underground NuriGO mall have no power, so night vision is recommended.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-turn-on-vr: On PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, Variable Refresh Rate must be enabled to use Performance Mode in DMZ and the Campaign.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-use-free-l: Experienced players advise using the free loadouts or survival kits until you know the map, instead of risking expensive gear.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-extract-ea: Players commonly advise leaving once you have useful loot or have finished your objectives, rather than trying to do everything in one raid.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-fastest-xp: For players mainly after XP and camos before the 23rd, the advice is to focus on Story Missions, Dynamic Ops and killing AI, since DMZ XP also raises your MP level.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-play-quiet: Solo tips include using suppressed weapons, choosing fights carefully, moving on after making noise, listening for other players, and looting quiet areas early.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-prioritise: Guides recommend unlocking Secure Slots early so your most valuable items survive a death.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-start-in-l: Community guides advise new players to start in low-threat areas such as Cheongun Village or Songdo Wharf and to avoid the Chang-san bunker and the Nenshin Tech Complex until geared. Players also suggest using quiet early-access rounds to explore and extract materials for FOB upgrades.
/dmz/intel/field-manual#intel-plan-aroun: Exfil sites draw squads hoping to catch players with full bags. Clear the area and re-plate before calling the helicopter, ping a second exfil as a fallback, and have one player call while the rest watch the approaches. If the smoke is already small, someone else called it and may be waiting nearby.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-soft-lock-withou: Early-access players who sold or deleted their starting Medkit, or dismissed the operator carrying it, could not finish the Gear Up Order or deploy. Fixed on 20 Oct.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-crash-at-the-bre: Some players crashed when breaching a door in the onboarding mission Breaking New Ground. The 20 Oct hotfix fixed it.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-ps5-stutter-desy: PS5 players describe heavy stutter, animations and sound falling out of sync, and repeated crashes in the middle of matches during early access.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-dmz-capped-at-60: On PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, DMZ and the campaign only offer the 120Hz Performance Mode with VRR switched on and a 120Hz display. Without both they stay at 60 fps by design, which many players took for a bug.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-backpack-keybind: On PC, the backpack sometimes cannot be opened with its key. A remapped backpack key shows correctly at the FOB but the default key is still used in a match.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-battle-net-updat: Several Battle.net users say the early access update hung on the applying stage for one to more than two hours.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-dmz-still-locked: For a while after launch, some pre-order owners, including Vault Edition owners on PS5 and Steam users, still saw DMZ as locked while others were already playing.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-lower-performanc: Steam players report lower frame rates than on Battle.net, crashes with DirectX errors, packet loss of up to about 3%, and screen tearing on capable hardware.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-stranded-campaig: Players of the campaign mission Stranded, a DMZ-like sandbox, report several bugs: the jammer site icon is in the wrong place on the map, weapons vanish when swapped with backpack items, players get trapped between rail cars, a four-gun loadout cannot be stowed, and checkpoints are inconsistent.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-no-crossplay-tog: Console players note there is no option to turn off crossplay in DMZ at early access.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-free-loadout-spa: Under investigation since 21 Oct on all platforms: some players who deploy with the Free Loadout arrive in Hajin with no weapons equipped. No workaround has been posted.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-operator-prestig: Some players cannot Prestige an Active Duty Operator even after meeting the requirements (under investigation, all platforms). Activision's workaround is to meet the weapon requirement with Rare (blue) weapons that have only three attachment slots, meaning weapons that have never carried four or more attachments.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-gunsmith-camos-a: Under investigation since 21 Oct: applying some weapon camos or reticles in the DMZ Gunsmith can take DMZ Cash from your balance.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-enemy-ai-not-cou: Known issue since 21 Oct: backstabbing enemy AI does not count toward challenges that ask for Backstab kills.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-no-dmz-launch-bu: Some Xbox on PC players get no button in COD Home to launch Campaign or DMZ after installing. Activision is investigating and suggests installing 'Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Content Pack 1' before launching and checking the Microsoft Store limit of 10 devices.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-dog-tag-case-sta: Fixed on 21 Oct. An error stopped some players from opening the Dog Tag Case station in the FOB. Trello marked it Fix Released the same day and it appears in the 21 Oct patch notes.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-disconnects-wipi: On the morning of 21 Oct many DMZ matches crashed or dropped players, who lost what they had looted. CODUpdates said a possible fix went out that afternoon: players hit by it keep their starting equipment and progression, but not loot collected in that match. Trello lists it as Fix Released.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-after-action-rep: Fixed on 20 Oct. After a player's first match the After-Action Report could show 0 XP earned. GamerFuzion points out the official wording treats it as a display error rather than lost XP.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-double-story-mis: Fixed on 20 Oct. Players could receive completion credit twice for a story mission; the hotfix removed this.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-commander-xp-onl: Fixed on 20 Oct. In a squad, only the player who landed the killing blow on a Commander received XP and King Slayer calling card progress. Every squad member is now credited.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-impact-smokes-no: Fixed on 20 Oct. The Impact Smokes Pro Trait could fail to release its smoke when the player was downed.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-ai-running-over-: Enemy AI could run players over while they were infilling. A first fix landed on 20 Oct and a second on 21 Oct for infils into NK Wilderness.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-keypad-code-safe: Fixed on 20 Oct. In some Dynamic Ops that ask you to find keypad codes in safes, the safes could spawn inside locked spaces.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-toxic-intercept-: Fixed on 21 Oct. The Toxic Intercept Dynamic Op could fail even after the squad completed its Defend the Bomb objective.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-chemical-denial-: Fixed on 20 Oct. On Nintendo Switch 2 a missing interaction prompt could stop progress in the Chemical Denial Dynamic Op at NuriGO Mall.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-untrack-recipe-k: Fixed on 20 Oct. Choosing Untrack Recipe at the 3D Printer with no recipe tracked could throw the player out of the FOB.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-heartbeat-sensor: Fixed on 21 Oct. On PC, holding a Heartbeat Sensor with a weapon equipped caused a performance drop.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-iso-apex-attachm: Fixed on 20 Oct. The ISO Apex Attachment did not work as intended in DMZ.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-players-stuck-in: Fixed on 20 Oct. Some rocky spots in Hajin could trap players; Infinity Ward patched several of them.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-saved-blueprint-: Fixed on 20 Oct. Nintendo Switch 2 players could not buy saved Blueprint modifications in DMZ.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-gunsmith-attachm: Fixed on 20 Oct. The Gunsmith Attachment menu could stay on screen while deploying into a match.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-active-duty-oper: Fixed on 20 Oct. Players could not equip an Active Duty Operator in their Showcase.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-possum-revive-bu: Some Possum users get the hold-to-revive prompt but holding the button does nothing, so they die anyway. In another case the body disappeared from the map when a teammate started reviving during the Possum last stand, leaving no way back.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-bank-money-disap: Players report DMZ Cash vanishing from the Bank between matches without spending it. One Steam player's balance dropped from about $90,000 to $37,000 after a death, without paying for a rescue.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-dmz-camo-challen: Some weapon camo challenges in DMZ stay at zero: one player got no progress toward 100 kills from behind with the M4, another got none toward a Hans gold camo after 100 kills and two extractions.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-operator-kills-a: Some players' operator-kill count and bounty stay at zero or one despite several player kills, and every Dog Tag they collect shows as Steel I.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-night-vision-gog: On controller, NVGs share the right D-pad with consumables like Smelling Salts, so you may use the item instead of the goggles. Highlighting the NVGs in the inventory and pressing the right stick equips them. Other players could not take NVGs off after leaving a dark area.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-stack-splitting-: On mouse and keyboard the prompted split-stack button can do nothing. A player found that binding Keybinds > Overlay Advanced Keybinds > Request to a key lets you split stacks with it, even though the on-screen prompt doesn't change.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-ddos-freezes-pla: Getting hit by a DDOS while flying a recon drone at the casino can lock the whole character, not just the drone: players could not move, shoot or change stance and died to bots, losing their loot. One says a boss hit them with it.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-survival-kits-ca: Pressing Claim on Survival Kits at the FOB sometimes does nothing, even with free stash space. One player could claim them after coming back from a story mission.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-low-dmz-frame-ra: PC players get far lower frame rates in DMZ than in the campaign, and lowering the resolution barely helps, which points to a CPU limit. One player blames the large number of AI.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-pay-for-lieutena: The Pay for Lieutenant Intel task can fail to tick after buying intel at the Boss Board, stalling the orders page. One player got it to count by switching the bought intel to The Doctor several times, and a guide video has a fix section for it.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-dmz-early-access: DMZ Early Access started on 20 October 2026 for anyone who digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased the Standard Digital or Vault Edition. Infinity Ward said it would be live everywhere by 10 AM PT.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-full-launch: Modern Warfare 4, with DMZ, launches worldwide on Friday 23 October 2026.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-campaign-early-a: Campaign Early Access for digital pre-orders began 16 October 2026, four days before DMZ Early Access.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-platforms: DMZ is on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2 and PC (Battle.net, Steam, Xbox on PC), but not on PS4 or Xbox One. Modern Warfare 4 is a separate purchase and not on Game Pass at launch.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-vault-edition-dm: The Vault Edition includes extra DMZ content at launch; the FOB guide shows it as a Deployment Kit plus an extra Active Duty slot and the Signature Weapon Blueprints.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-mrbeast-dmz-chal: Call of Duty promoted a MrBeast DMZ challenge: 10 teams compete for $1M, each starting with 100K, taking other teams' dog tags and cash and keeping only what they extract.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-pre-launch-backe: On 19 October 2026 CODUpdates announced minor backend updates in preparation for DMZ Early Access.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-season-1: Season 1 starts 6 November for MW4 and Warzone. Hajin becomes a Warzone Battle Royale map, Zodiac arrives for Resurgence, and the Battle Pass and BlackCell go live. DMZ-specific Season 1 changes have not been formally announced.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-season-2: The Russian part of Hajin is fogged off at launch and opens with Season 2 as a map expansion.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-pre-season-1-roa: Infinity Ward's roadmap: Shipment on 27 Oct, Possession mode on 29 Oct and Infected on 30 Oct, all multiplayer; nothing DMZ-specific between launch and Season 1.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-anti-cheat-requi: DMZ uses Ricochet with Server Culling. PC players need TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot enabled.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-stranded-campaig: Campaign mission 10, Stranded, is an open sandbox with a backpack, resource gathering, crafting, notes, outposts and side objectives. Weapons you find there are stored at your base, so players used it to practise before DMZ.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-no-separate-dmz-: Unlike multiplayer, MW4 DMZ had no public beta or playtest before early access.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-post-launch-supp: Developers say early seasons are being tested and they plan to support and evolve the mode, without committing to DMZ beyond MW4. A new map called XO1, compared to Building 21, arrives in Season 1, the Russian part of Hajin opens in Season 2, and more maps are planned after XO1.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-patch-20-oct-202: First DMZ Early Access hotfix, applied on 20 Oct and posted by CODUpdates early on 21 Oct. It lists 19 DMZ fixes and no balance changes, covering crashes (including the Breaking New Ground door breach), a 0 XP After-Action Report, double story-mission credit, squad Commander XP, the Impact Smokes Pro Trait, AI…
/dmz/intel/status#intel-patch-21-oct-202: Second batch of DMZ fixes, listed as 'Addressed on Oct. 21' in the Launch Patch Notes: the Dog Tag Case error, Toxic Intercept failing after Defend the Bomb, a PC slowdown when holding a Heartbeat Sensor, AI running over players during the NK Wilderness infil, plus menu-text, reward-image and voice-line fixes.
/dmz/intel/status#intel-no-weekly-challe: Infinity Ward says Season 1 will have no Weekly Challenges. It will run a mix of new and returning Events instead, with rewards such as Apex Attachments, camos, calling cards and Operator skins. Events will recur so a missed track can be finished later, finishing several Events earns extra camos, and the first Event…
